adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `blacklistedGuestEmails` are lowercased (`.map((email) => email.toLowerCase())`) but the filter compares with the raw `guest` string: `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)`, so a blacklisted email with different casing can bypass the blocklist. The attendee dedupe is also case-sensitive: `!booking.attendees.some((attendee) => guest === attendee.email)`, allowing duplicates like `Foo@Bar.com` vs `foo@bar.com` if the stored attendee email casing differs. The diff shows no normalization (e.g., `.toLowerCase()`) on incoming `guests` before these checks.
